scope_note: This preserves Freud's 1912 classification; it does not imply that all later transference theory uses only this binary.
statement: Freud's 1912 account distinguished positive transference of affectionate feelings from negative transference of hostile feelings.
statement_zh: Freud 1912 年的說明區分了帶有親愛情感的正向移情，以及帶有敵意情感的負向移情。
